allow.finding: docs/all.ar.html 1440 · dark · RTL · Arabic - #drawer-filters-panel from button.btn leaves the viewport
allow.reason: Chrome 130 puts fixed boxes 15 px to the left in a right-to-left page whose root keeps a stable scrollbar gutter - as html:has(dialog:modal) does while a modal is open - so a drawer at the end edge loses 7 px; Chrome 136 places it right (measured 2026-10-28). The gutter stays: without it every engine shifts the page when a modal opens.
